jaws.installer: Vendor network installer; downloaded payloads are vendor verified, not independently locked here. The bridge attests the running product version.
jaws.license: No activation or licensing bypass. Use an existing valid JAWS license or the vendor's time-limited demonstration mode.

capture: JAWS Remote Command Server (AT Driver), interaction.capturedOutput. Evidence is the text JAWS sends for speech, not recorded audio or braille.
windows: Docker runs a real x64 Windows VM. A valid Windows license remains the operator's responsibility. ARM64 hosts without KVM use slow native QEMU software emulation.
